items.title: Kimberly-Clark’s 54-Year Dividend Streak Faces Its Biggest Test Yet With $48.7 Billion Kenvue Deal
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark just raised its dividend for the 54th straight year while simultaneously chasing a nearly $50 billion acquisition, and income investors are now weighing whether a deal of that size can coexist with a payout that costs over $1.6 billion annually.
